name: Banks are acquired: receiving the bank item grants the bank, and both routes share the ten-minute cooldown
contract: A bank is not part of AscensionCompat.UnlockAllVanity - it is obtained, and the item is what obtains it. A character that has not received one does not know its summon spell and cannot open a placed chest. Handing the bank item to a character - what a shop or a grant does - records the account's own acquisition and grants the summon spell at once, with no relog. After that the item and the spell are the same act: either places the same vault and starts the same ten-minute cooldown, the value the vault's lifetime is matched to. Placing the vault, its despawn and the rule that anyone holding a bank may use a chest someone else placed are outside this harness's reach.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
An unacquired Personal Bank grants no summon spell, even with everything unlocked
An unacquired Realm Bank grants no summon spell either
And neither bank item is in the bag yet
Acquire the Personal Bank: the shop hands over the bank item
The Personal Bank item is in the bag
Receiving the bank item acquires the bank and grants its spell with no relog
The newly acquired bank starts off cooldown
Summon through the item, the bag route
Let the vault summon land in the world
Using the item starts the ten-minute cooldown that the vault's lifetime matches
The summon does not consume the item
Acquire the Realm Bank the same way
The Realm Bank's spell follows its item
Summon the Realm Bank from the spell alone, with no item in hand
Let the vault summon land in the world
Casting the spell starts the same ten-minute cooldown
